model_notes: Display topology: eDP-1 is the internal 5K panel primary link; DP-1 is the panel's second link (reported disconnected in single-link operation); DP-2 and DP-3 are the two external Thunderbolt 2 / Mini DisplayPort ports.
External display over Mini DisplayPort to DisplayPort (passive cable) works at 3840x2160.
FaceTime HD ('EyeSight') camera works. It is not a PCI device, so the collectors do not match it to a component record.
Thunderbolt (thunderbolt driver) and the SD card reader (sdhci-pci) bind and are detected.
